name: KB · Sessiz lüks
rationale: The owner asked for a corporate page that does not look like every other corporate page. This one says almost nothing: warm off-white paper, one near-black ink at three strengths, a single deep accent that is almost never used, no decoration, no box rules, and a lot of air. Every picture is the real product — actual sextant frames and crops of them, never an illustration. Read, not announced.
notes: Composition: a left-aligned 1200px grid — section eyebrow, heading and lead sit on the left column, content below. The exception is the owner's own pick: the hero and the closing CTA are centred in a 40–44rem measure with 6–9rem of vertical air, and only those two. Headings sit left in 6 of 8 sections and shift to the right column in 2 (Capabilities, Providers via Section `shift`); no strict alternation is claimed. Contrast: text-muted 6.4:1 and text-faint 5.35:1 on the paper, 5.0:1 on surface-2; terminal faint 5.0:1 on ink — every caption and every 11–12px mono command string a reader would copy passes AA. Type is small and light: display 300, h2 28–36px, body 16px, captions 11px spaced uppercase in text-faint. No cards except the frame bezel and code blocks (surface lift by one wide soft shadow, never an outline). No colour accent word in the headline. Images, all real: two full sextant frames (hero Device, Terminal Shot) and five crops of frames (cockpit, messages, rmrf, rewind, tests), the weather-cloud mascot exactly twice (statement line, close — owner insisted it stays), the mark twice (header, footer). Motion: none on entrance — the built page is static (STATIC) and every component renders its finished state, the transcript included; the one motion is the Terminal frame's 2× lens on a hovered callout (500ms, off under reduced motion); copy buttons and the accordion have plain 150–300ms transitions. No video, no isobars, no chart marks. rejected: navy+glass (r1), storm-red/Schibsted (r2), light-sky/Fraunces/full-bleed video (r3-4), C canlı motion pass (r5), K2 lacivert band + beyaz gövde/Geist (r6, 'too classic'), R3 hava haritası/IBM Plex/chart-red (r7, 'not corporate'). Owner's tells to avoid: amber, hero for its own sake, unrelated typefaces, too many lines, too angular, everything stacked down the middle (accepted only for the hero/CTA measure, by the owner's own pick).
